# WhiteBite/LocalGitMirror

> Personal cross-machine tool that bridges a restricted corporate work environment and a free home environment through one self-hosted encrypted git/deps mirror, for developers moving code, MR reviews and dependencies between two PCs without cloud.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, LLM-friendly index of the project.
